How does Twilio Segment Connections pricing work?

Pricing scales with monthly tracked users (MTUs) — the unique users you collect data on each month. Free covers 1,000 visitors at $0. Team starts at $120/month for 10,000, then adds $10 per 1,000 visitors beyond that. Business is custom volume — contact sales for a quote.
What's an MTU and how do I estimate mine?

An MTU, or monthly tracked user, is any unique user Twilio Segment collects data on in a billing month (identified or anonymous). Estimate yours by tallying the monthly unique visitors and users across the sites and apps you'll connect. Overshooting is common, so start conservative and scale up.
Which Connections plan is right for me?
Start with your data volume and complexity:
Free: Testing or small projects for 1,000 visitors, 2 sources, one warehouse destination.
Team: Up 10,000 visitors, unlimited sources, public API access.
Business: Complex needs, custom visitor volume, data governance, and HIPAA-eligibility.
Is the free plan enough, or do I need Team?

The free plan works if you're pulling from a couple of sources and syncing to one warehouse once a day. Move up to Team once you pass 1,000 visitors, need unlimited sources, want twice-daily syncs, or need public API access to build on top of your data.
What's the difference between the Customer Data Pipeline and the Customer Data Platform?

Customer Data Pipeline (Connections) collects your data and routes it to destinations with 700+ out-of-the-box integrations. The Twilio Segment Customer Data Platform adds identity resolution, unified profiles, audience building, journey orchestration, and out-of-the-box predictive AI models on top. Connections move your data, and the CDP makes sense of it with added targeting orchestration and activation. Many teams start with Connections and layer on CDP later.
Is there a free trial, and what does annual billing save?

Team plans includes a 14-day free trial, so you can test paid features before you commit. Annual billing lets you buy MTUs at a lower rate than month-to-month, though going over your allotted MTUs on an annual plan can add charges. The Free plan stays free permanently, capped at 1,000 visitors.
